title: The Blue Castle: a novel
author: L. M. (Lucy Maud) Montgomery
hook: Told she has a year to live, a downtrodden spinster starts saying exactly what she thinks.

title: The strange case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
hook: A cautious London lawyer follows a friend's ugly secret through fog and locked doors toward something he cannot bring himself to name.

title: Moby Dick; Or, The Whale
author: Herman Melville
hook: A restless sailor signs onto a whaling ship and discovers her captain is hunting one particular whale.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
hook: Five sisters, two eligible newcomers, and a young woman who trusts her own judgment a little too far.

title: As You Like It
author: William Shakespeare
hook: Banished to a forest, a sharp-tongued heiress disguises herself as a boy and teaches her admirer how to woo.

title: Middlemarch
author: George Eliot
hook: In a small English town, an ardent young woman and an ambitious young doctor each set out to do something great.

title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
hook: Twelve cases in which a hat, a note or a scuffed boot gives a stranger's whole life away.

title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
hook: A bored girl follows a waistcoated rabbit underground into a world that argues back and refuses to make sense.

title: The Expedition of Humphry Clinker
author: T. (Tobias) Smollett
hook: Five very different letter-writers describe one journey around Britain, and no two of them see a single thing the same way.

title: Frankenstein; or, the modern prometheus
author: Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley
hook: A young scientist gives life to a being he cannot bear to look at, and cannot escape.

title: Romeo and Juliet
author: William Shakespeare
hook: Two teenagers from feuding families meet at a party and decide, within hours, to marry in secret.

title: Chaucer's Works, Volume 2 — Boethius and Troilus
author: Geoffrey Chaucer
hook: Two Middle English masterworks: a ruined statesman visited by Philosophy herself, and a Trojan prince caught by love during the siege.
